local p=game.Players.LocalPlayer
local v=p.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("AvatarPortrait3D",true)
assert(v,"Viewport missing")
local c=v:FindFirstChild("PortraitCharacter",true)
local face=c and c:FindFirstChild("FaceExpression",true)
local h=c and c:FindFirstChild("Head")
local scripts,bones,welds=0,0,0
if c then for _,d in c:GetDescendants() do if d:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") then scripts+=1 elseif d:IsA("Bone") then bones+=1 elseif d:IsA("JointInstance") or d:IsA("WeldConstraint") then welds+=1 end end end
return game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONEncode({exists=true,visible=v.Visible,imageTransparency=v.ImageTransparency,backgroundTransparency=v.BackgroundTransparency,viewportSize={v.AbsoluteSize.X,v.AbsoluteSize.Y},viewportPosition={v.AbsolutePosition.X,v.AbsolutePosition.Y},costumeId=v:GetAttribute("CostumeId"),cloneChildren=c and #c:GetDescendants(),scripts=scripts,bones=bones,welds=welds,faceTexture=face and face.TextureID,cameraDistance=h and (v.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position-h.Position).Magnitude,characterCostume=p:GetAttribute("CostumeApplied")})
